items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: One day Claude Jones did it, though. Claude Jones, he could actually pass. Claude Jones did it -- we were side-tracked into this -- right across, old beat grease joint, Claude Jones, went on in the restaurant, sat down at the counter and they served him.

ctx.x: was a Southerner, I was used to that. I'd been run out of places in Nashville, as a kid. After playing a beautiful job, like out to the Belle Meade Country Club, I was coming out one night after finishing a job and we were (unintelligible) bringing the instruments, and a white girl and her boyfriend, people coming home from -- she said mister, can I beat on your drum and I said, Lady, no, she said -- and the guy said, well if we can't beat on that drum, we're going to beat on your head, so I put the drums, and I…

One day Claude Jones did it, though. Claude Jones, he could actually pass. Claude Jones did it -- we were side-tracked into this -- right across, old beat grease joint, Claude Jones, went on in the restaurant, sat down at the counter and they served him. We didn't do it, but he could pass.

So, I think Lamar Wright (unintelligible) spied him, you know, in there and I think Lamar Wright (unintelligible) somebody went in there and sat down by him and said oh, if Claude could go in there, so -- I think it was Lamar, went in there sat down beside him and the man, said what the hell are you -- you know and then ran Claude and Lamar out of the joint.
